bash: cd /app/polyglot && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess
def ref(n):
    a,b=0,1
    for _ in range(n): a,b=b,a+b
    return a
bad=0
for n in list(range(0,40))+[50,90,100,200,500,1000]:
    c=subprocess.run(['./cmain',str(n)],capture_output=True,text=True)
    p=subprocess.run(['python3','main.py.c',str(n)],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if c.returncode!=0 or p.returncode!=0:
        print('rc',n,c.returncode,p.returncode,c.stderr,p.stderr); bad+=1; continue
    if c.stdout!=p.stdout or c.stdout.strip()!=str(ref(n)):
        print('MISMATCH',n,c.stdout[:40],p.stdout[:40]); bad+=1
print('bad =',bad)
EOF
